label: book-return-a
observation: The first caller overwrites eax after the set insertion returns.

label: book-return-b
observation: The second caller overwrites eax after the set insertion returns.

label: book-slot-flow-a
observation: First caller window between the slot-writer return and user-set insertion.

label: book-slot-flow-b
observation: Second caller window between the slot-writer return and user-set insertion.

label: book-allocated-slot-a
observation: The allocator return is saved as the key used later in this book path.

label: book-allocated-slot-b
observation: The allocator return is retained in r15 for the later set call.

label: book-site-a
observation: Book user lookup result plus 0x20 is passed to the set writer.

label: book-site-b
observation: Second book context passes the same user-entry field to the writer.

label: book-set-split-call
observation: The book-context set writer calls the selected split body.

label: set-wrapper-entry
observation: Load set root and branch on null.

label: set-wrapper-search
observation: Search live u64 keys and descend by height; equality returns one.

label: set-wrapper-empty
observation: Allocate and initialize a 0x68-byte empty root.

label: set-wrapper-first
observation: Guard capacity, store key, increment tree count, return zero.

label: set-wrapper-insert
observation: Build cursor, call split helper and increment tree count.

label: set-wrapper-fail
observation: Allocation failure and capacity assertion sites.

label: leaf-nonfull
observation: Node length below 11 takes nonfull insertion and suffix shift.

label: leaf-choose
observation: Full-leaf pivot and side selection on index 5 and 6.

label: leaf-split
observation: Allocate 0x68 bytes, copy upper keys and update both lengths.

label: leaf-place
observation: Choose sibling and insert new key at its local index.

label: parent-climb
observation: Ascend via parent pointer and check height; test parent capacity.

label: parent-choose
observation: Full-parent pivot and side selection on index 5 and 6.

label: parent-split
observation: Allocate 0xc8-byte internal sibling and repair moved child links.

label: parent-place
observation: Insert promoted key and new edge into selected parent.

label: parent-repair
observation: Repair child parent pointers and parent-edge indices.

label: new-root
observation: Allocate an internal root, increase height and attach both children.

label: parent-nonfull
observation: Shift a nonfull parent and install key and edge.

label: return-cursor
observation: Return three cursor words.

label: split-failure
observation: Bounds, height, allocation and assertion failure arms.
